name: ai-workspace
description: Full-stack AI workspace chatbot: Next.js + Tailwind client, Express + MongoDB server

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
